subtopics.title: What is a Network?
subtopics.theory: A network is a group of interconnected devices that can communicate with each other through a set of rules called protocols.

subtopics.title: Physical Layer
subtopics.theory: The physical layer is responsible for the transmission of unstructured raw data between a computer and a physical transmission medium.

subtopics.title: Data Link Layer
subtopics.theory: The data link layer is responsible for the reliable transmission of data frames between nodes over a physical network link.

subtopics.title: Process States
subtopics.theory: Processes can exist in various states: new, ready, running, waiting, and terminated.

subtopics.title: Virtual Memory
subtopics.theory: Virtual memory is a memory management technique that provides an idealized abstraction of the storage resources.
